note: AI and GPU clouds. They host models and GPU workloads, not whole applications. Pick one as a primary provider to design a model-serving system, or add one next to another provider with --also.

any: Runs your containers on Kubernetes close to GPU capacity.

any.caveat: Adds Kubernetes you would have to operate.

any: GPU nodes in a Kubernetes cluster for model training and serving.
S3-compatible object storage next to the GPUs.
A private network for your cluster.

any.caveat: Check current VPC availability and regions in the CoreWeave documentation.

gaps.serverless: Use the server-based model on CKS.
gaps.db_postgres: Use a managed PostgreSQL from another provider, or run one on CKS.
gaps.cache: Run Redis on CKS or use a managed Redis elsewhere.
gaps.ingress: Use an ingress controller on CKS.
gaps.observability: CoreWeave provides cluster metrics; add your own logging stack.
gaps.managed_ai: Run open models yourself on the GPUs.

any: GPU virtual machines you run your containers and models on.

any.caveat: You run and patch the machines yourself.

any: GPU virtual machines for model training and serving.
Persistent storage attached to your GPU instances.
Hosted open models behind an API.

gaps.serverless: Use the server-based model on a GPU instance.
gaps.db_postgres: Use a managed PostgreSQL from another provider.
gaps.cache: Run Redis on the instance or use a managed Redis elsewhere.
gaps.ingress: Run a reverse proxy on the instance.

server: GPU containers that run as long as you keep them on.
serverless: GPU workers that scale with requests, including to zero.

serverless.caveat: Cold starts load the model again; keep active workers if latency matters.

any: GPU containers for model training and serving.
Persistent storage you can attach to pods and workers.

gaps.db_postgres: Use a managed PostgreSQL from another provider.
gaps.cache: Use a managed Redis from another provider.
gaps.ingress: RunPod exposes HTTPS proxies for pods and endpoints.
gaps.observability: RunPod shows logs and metrics for pods and workers in its console.
gaps.network: Use RunPod's built-in isolation; there is no VPC to configure.

any: Reserved GPU clusters for training and serving.
Hosted open models behind an API, serverless or on dedicated endpoints.
Model endpoints on GPUs reserved for you.

any.caveat: Together AI hosts models, not general applications; run the app elsewhere.

gaps.serverless: The Inference API is serverless for models; applications need another provider.
gaps.db_postgres: Use a managed PostgreSQL from another provider.
gaps.storage: Use object storage from another provider.
gaps.ingress: Together AI serves its own API endpoints.
gaps.observability: Use the usage and logs views in the Together AI console.
